name: Cindy Xiong Bearfield
bio: Cindy Xiong Bearfield is an Assistant Professor in the School of Interactive Computing at Georgia Tech. Cindy's expertise in human perception and cognition will help us understand how and when to approach evaluations so that researchers can explain the whys behind their observations.

name: David Gotz
bio: David Gotz is a Professor of Information Science at the UNC School of Information and Library Science (SILS). He also serves as Director for both the Carolina Health Informatics Program and UNC's Certificate in Applied Data Science (CADS). He spent nearly a decade as a Research Scientist at the IBM T.J. Watson Research Center, New York, NY, USA before returning to join the UNC faculty in 2014.

name: Alex Kale
bio: Alex Kale is an Assistant Professor in Computer Science and the Data Science Institute at the University of Chicago. He earned his PhD in Information Science at the University of Washington in 2022. Alex leads the Data Cognition Lab at the University of Chicago, focused on creating data visualization and analysis software that explicitly represents users' cognitive processes around data.

name: Bum Chul Kwon
bio: Bum Chul Kwon is a research scientist at IBM Research, Cambridge, MA. He earned a PhD in Industrial Engineering from Purdue University in 2013. He builds and evaluates AI models, visual analytics systems, and agentic workflows, applying them to unlock deeper insights, address healthcare and life sciences challenges, tell compelling data-driven stories, and advance data visualization literacy.

name: Klaus Mueller
bio: Klaus Mueller is a professor in the Computer Science Department at Stony Brook University and a senior scientist at the Computational Science Initiative at Brookhaven National Lab. He chaired the IEEE Visualization Conference in 2009, served as elected Chair of the IEEE Technical Committee on Visualization and Computer Graphics (VGTC) from 2012–2015, and was Editor-in-Chief of IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics from 2019–2022. He is a member of the VGTC Visualization Academy and a Fellow of the IEEE.
